name: rpg-factory
description: Repository-specific development Factory for the UnityIndie RPG MMO workspace.

plugins.name: rpg-factory
plugins.description: Development workflow orchestration for the UnityIndie RPG MMO workspace (server, client, Netcode, UnityDots, UIToolkit): Factory Core plus 8 specialised skills, deterministic routing with enforced execution modes, module registry with cross-repo contracts and pin watchers, a check runner with tree-bound evidence (STALE/NOT_RUN), derived cross-repo status, status/route/check/doctor commands, and guards for git, GitHub and file tools with a persistent tripwire. Agents never tag.
